title: 60 Minutes Private Photography session in Barcelona
text: This was just a fabulous way to capture our family pictures in Barcelona!  The photos were so different than what we could have ever done by ourselves and such an amazing memory of our trip!
author: 692jasmineh

title: Amazing Memories !
text: Heard about Flytographer on Instagram and was skeptical although I was intrigued and wanted professional family pictures while in Spain. Then our friends mentioned they had done a photo shoot in Italy and used Flytographer and they would recommend it to anyone and would do it on all future vacations. I was sold. Now I am a follower and will use Flytographer on all future vacations whether in the US or abroad. Experience was smooth and priced very well. Pics were great.
author: 609at

title: Family pictures!
text: Ramon was amazing.  Super friendly, helpful, full of ideas, timely and just a pleasure to work with.  Would absolutely recommend him for any local photography needs!
author: Karen A

title: Incredible Experience & Amazing Photos!
text: My husband & I booked with Flytographer via the recommendation of our travel agent. It was *the best* thing we could have done for our vacation! Because we knew we had 60 mins of our trip dedicated to taking some really nice photos, we were able to put down our phones & really be present for the rest of it. It was so great to be so grounded & calm for our vacation! Thanks Flytographer!
author: Amy H

title: Fun family photoshoot in Barcelona
text:
We used Flytographer to arrange us a photographer at the end of our month long family vacation through Europe. The site and process is so simple. You get to preview all the available photographers and select the one with the style you love the best to book. Flytographer than do the rest to arrange your meeting, get your preferences etc before the shoot so that it runs super smoothly. 

We loved our time with Ramon & Sonia in Barcelona and our photos are amazing, so much more and better than we expected, they made us look great! It was a really fun afternoon with them, making us all feel relaxe
author: nadiafeeney
